title: Cell encoding depends on core data
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, let $s$ be a natural number, and let $C,D$ be configurations on input $x$. If $C$ and $D$ agree in their state, input-head position, work-tape contents, work-tape head positions, and output summary, then their encoded cell functions on the window of radius $s$ are equal.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols
The core data and output summaries of $C$ and $D$ agree
